description: Generates a new original instrumental track for this listing, the same as Create in the Music panel. It suits a request for a new, custom, original or generated track, with the style that fits best (the person says yes before it runs) and a short direction: mood, instruments, pacing, tied to this listing, without an artist or song name. It takes a couple of minutes and counts as one of this listing's music generations. The finished track waits in the Music panel for the person to play and approve. On a Full control connection it starts at once; otherwise it returns a confirmationId and waits for the owner's yes.

direction.description: Mood, instruments and pacing in a sentence or two, for example: warm, unhurried acoustic guitar and soft piano for a family home, building gently.

style.description: Optional starting style from the Create tab.
